I switched from an iPhone to an Android phone last week. My texts to my sister stay stuck on sending in Google Messages. What should I check?

Check these in Google Messages on your Android phone.
1. Make sure you have the most updated version of **Google Messages**.
2. If you have a SIM card, ensure that it is inserted properly.
3. Verify that **Google Messages** is set as your default texting app.
4. Check your plan or credit balance to see that you have enough to send/receive messages.
5. See if you have signal.
6. Check if you're on airplane mode. If you are, turn it off.
7. If you're switching from an iPhone, make sure you've deactivated iMessage for your number.

Your screen has stopped responding completely. These steps are for screens that are too sensitive or respond only sometimes. They may not help a screen that does not respond at all.
1. Restart your iPhone.
2. Make sure that your screen is clean and free of any debris or water.
3. Disconnect any Lightning or USB-C accessories.

5. Remove any cases or screen protectors.
6. If your screen still isn't working, you might need to set up service for your device.
